title: NZ MBIE Determination 2025/035 (comparative): as-built cedar weatherboards with double-nail fixings
jurisdiction: New Zealand (Building Act 2004); Auckland Council; comparative only, not Alberta
code_edition: NZ Building Code (Schedule 1, Building Regulations 1992) as cited; B2/AS1 and E2/AS1 referenced (editions not stated in extracted text)
source_url_note: Building CodeHub resource page for the same MBIE determination (Information provider: MBIE); the building.govt.nz determination page is WAF-blocked for this worker.

facts.text: The dispute concerns horizontal rusticated cedar weatherboard cladding on a recently constructed detached dwelling, and whether the as-built double-nail fixings comply with B2 and E2.
The building consent for the dwelling including the cladding was granted and issued on 6 June 2018, and building work started in August 2018.
A minor variation approved during construction replaced the specified pine bevel-backed weatherboards with 18 mm rusticated cedar weatherboards.
Figure 1 shows the building consent detail and Figure 2 shows the as-built construction.
The weatherboard manufacturer stated that the weatherboard was installed outside the scope of its system.
